searchText: I think the calls are recorded. <@642887713246150666> where do they end up? Ah. Found it: https://youtu.be/htwlb08kueg Thanks for sharing <@301186049323958275> ! These calls are available on ECH YouTube and links are generally shared on (meeting update) channel on ECH discord. Notes are available here https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/blob/master/All%20EIPIP%20Meetings/Meeting%20050.md I know that many of you are from Europe. If you you have loved ones affected by the crisis in Ukraine, I wish them health. <@!425279588009246720> <@!301186049323958275> <@!543900561460822016> checking in on sending 4626 to last call! https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4751 Want to announce to get more eyes on it <a:CatJam:749637020946661487>
